evals.prompt: Use Agnes AI to edit C:/workspace/assets/product.png. Make the bottle matte black, keep the logo and composition unchanged, generate a 2K 4:3 image, and save the result under C:/workspace/outputs/product-edit.
evals.expected_output: Uses image generate with capability image-to-image, converts the local PNG to a Data URI, selects agnes-image-2.1-flash with 2K and 4:3, and reports the downloaded local image path from the normalized result.

evals.prompt: Generate a five-second 16:9 Agnes video of a camera moving through a quiet neon city at night. Wait for completion and download the MP4 into ./outputs/neon-city.
evals.expected_output: Uses video generate with text-to-video, 121 frames at 24 FPS and 1152x768 defaults, polls by video_id without repeating the creation POST, and reports the downloaded MP4 and effective returned dimensions.

evals.prompt: My Agnes video generation timed out locally, but I kept video_id video_demo_42. Resume waiting for that existing task and download it when ready; do not create another video.
evals.expected_output: Uses video wait with video_demo_42, does not call video create or video generate, preserves the task ID on another timeout, and reports the local artifact path if the task completes.
